title: Klarna CEO: We are a 'neobank' but people still associate us with buy now, pay later
summary: Klarna's CEO discusses winning Walmart from Affirm, the DoorDash partnership, and Klarna's neobank ambitions.

assertions.quote: I mean one often compares to affirm the truth is that they're much more of like a big ticket financier

verdicts.note: Broadly true of industry positioning between larger-ticket financing and everyday small-ticket financing, though most major providers now offer both.

assertions.quote: we can aggregate transactions from a whole month and put them at a bill at the end of the month

verdicts.note: A real mechanism: aggregated monthly billing can lower a merchant's effective debit or credit card processing costs compared to per-transaction card fees.

assertions.quote: Our card has been launched in the US and we're making upgrades to that

verdicts.note: Klarna and other BNPL providers have launched debit cards and broader banking-style products beyond simple installment lending.

assertions.quote: you also had DoorDash. This one made a lot of waves where you announced this buy now, pay later partnership

verdicts.note: Retailers do periodically switch BNPL partners for better economics, a normal competitive dynamic rather than a meaningful difference in consumer risk.
